<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-08-19

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **Muse Glimmer 30B** (Meta) — vision input, tool calling, and reasoning
- 🧠 **Muse Spark 1.2** (Meta) — vision input, tool calling, and reasoning; paid-only
- 🧠 **Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B** (Qwen) — tool calling and reasoning
- 🧠 **Grok 4.6** (xAI) — vision input, tool calling, and reasoning; paid-only
- 🎨 **Grok Imagine Image 2.0** (xAI) — image generation/editing at 1K or 2K; paid-only
- 🎨 **Qwen Image 3** (Qwen) — image generation/editing at 1K or 2K; paid-only
- 🎬 **MiniMax H3**, **Seedance 2.0 Fast/Mini**, and **Seedance 2.5** — paid video models with audio output
- 🔊 **Whisper Large V3 (Free)** (OrchidLLM Proxy) — audio transcription
- 57 community alpha text/image models also added

### 🗑️ Removed
- `grok-4.5`, `muse-spark-1.1` (text)
- 14 community text and 3 community image models

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🎨 Image: CloudCompile/agnes-image-2.0-flash (80%)
- 🧠 Text: gemini (75%) · MarcosFRG/deepseek-v4-flash (90%) · vendouple/gpt-5.6-sol (30%) · MarcosFRG/glm-5.2 (60%) · vendouple/deepseek-v4 (50%) · MarcosFRG/gemini-3.1-flash-lite (15%) · MarcosFRG/minimax-m3 (50%) · MarcosFRG/gemini-3-flash-preview (15%) · MarcosFRG/gemma-4-31b (25%)

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🧠 Text: deepseek-pro (completion +15%) · MarcosFRG/deepseek-v4-pro (+895%) · vendouple/kimi-k3 (+15%) · sharktide/inferenceport.ai-gpt-oss-20b (+330%) · sharktide/inferenceport-ai-kimi-k2.7-code (+100%)

- `vendouple/laguna-s-2.1:free` — added image input
- `sharktide/inferenceport-ai-mimo-v2.5` — added image, audio, and video input
